description: This file contains the implementation of the HolidayDao class, which manages database operations related to holidays in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, searching, and deleting holiday records, leveraging Doctrine ORM query builders and pagination features.

classes.name: HolidayDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for performing CRUD and search operations on Holiday entities within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Persists a Holiday entity to the database.

methods.name: getHolidayById
methods.description: Retrieves a Holiday entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingHolidayIds
methods.description: Returns a list of holiday IDs that exist in the database from a provided list.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Performs a search for holidays based on filter parameters and returns matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchHolidaysPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginated query for holidays based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHolidayByDate
methods.description: Finds a recurring holiday matching a specific date.
